name: Waneta Generating Station Upgrade
proponent: Teck Metals Limited and BC Hydro and Power Authority

commitments.text: Cominco must, within one month of the date of issuance of this Certificate, contribute $15,000 to the Canadian Columbia River Inter-Tribal Fisheries Commission (the CCRIFC) to enable its member First Nations to identify traditional uses in the vicinity of the Waneta Dam.

In respect of Condition 7, in addition to submitting to the Regional Manager, Environmental Protection, the Regional Fish, Wildlife and Habitat Manager and the Comptroller of Water Rights, Cominco must also submit copies of the same to the CCRIFC, DFO and the Project Assessment Director, Environmental Assessment Office.

Cominco must enter into an agreement with, and to the satisfaction of, the Comptroller of Water Rights that provides for the payment by Cominco of five years of monitoring of the effects of water discharges on white sturgeon reproduction and egg incubation, as required by this Certificate and the Mitigation and Compensation Plan.

In addition to submitting the reports required under Condition 7 to the Regional Manager, Environmental Protection, the Regional Fish, Wildlife and Habitat Manager and the Comptroller of Water Rights, Cominco must also submit copies of the same to the CCRIFC, DFO and the Project Assessment Director, Environmental Assessment Office.
